For bi-directional flow measurement the outlet pipe and flow conditioner shall be identical to the inlet. The installation of a temperature sensor is at 2–5D from the outlet of the meter. For bi-directional applications an additional temperature sensor can be installed 2–5D upstream of the meter. The central meter body, including welded piping or welded flanges, shall be calibrated as a meter package during the examination for putting into use of the gas meter. Additional information is recorded in document no. 10983/2-01. 101
